description: Search recorded retail listings across stores using explicit budget, currency, size, color and stock filters. 1 credit. Returns ranked purchase links with observed availability; unknown facts stay unknown. Misses may be saved as agent observations, never verified human demand.

in_stock.description: Filter recorded availability. Availability must be checked at retailer.

max_price.description: Maximum recorded price. Supply currency too; no currency conversion.

query.description: Short product category or name, e.g. keyboards, shoes or coffee. Put constraints in separate fields.

name: search_products
title: Search retail products
